claim.claim-text: 1. A system for producing an offset voltage for threshold voltage variation compensation, the system comprising: a first transistor (320) and a second transistor (330), wherein the offset voltage (VC_OS) is produced across a drain of the first transistor (320) and a source of the second transistor (330).
2. The system of claim 1, wherein the drain of the first transistor (320) is connected to a gate of the first transistor (320).
3. The system of claim 1 or 2, wherein a drain of the second transistor (330) is connected to a gate of the second transistor (330).
4. The system of any preceding claim, wherein a source of the first transistor (320) is connected to a supply voltage, and the drain of the first transistor (320) is connected to ground.
5. The system of any preceding claim, wherein the source of the second transistor (330) is connected to a supply voltage, and the drain of the second transistor (330) is connected to ground.
6. The system of any preceding claim, wherein the drain of the first transistor (320) is connected to ground via a resistor.
7. The system of any preceding claim, wherein the source of the second transistor (330) is connected to a supply voltage via a resistor.
8. The system of any preceding claim, the first and the second transistor (320, 330) each having a threshold voltage of a first voltage value.
9. The system of any preceding claim, configured to apply the offset voltage across a gate of a third transistor (220) and a source of a fourth transistor (230).
10. The system of claim 9, further configured to apply the offset voltage across a gate of the fourth transistor (230) and a source of the third transistor (220).
11. The system of claim 10, wherein a difference between a threshold voltage of the third or fourth transistor and the offset voltage is constant.
12. Circuitry, comprising: the system of any of claims 1-11, and a voltage level detector.
13. The circuitry of Claim 12, wherein a drain of the third transistor is connected to a first input of the voltage level detector.
14. The circuitry of Claim 13, wherein a drain of the fourth transistor is connected to a second input of the voltage level detector.
15. Automotive Ethernet, comprising the system of any of claims 1-11, and the circuitry of any of claims 12-14.
